title: Ukugqitha eLwandle
intro: Umi phezu kwentlabathi yonxweme olulityaliweyo, apho amaza ehlebeza uluntu oluvavanywa ngumyalelo kaThixo. Umoya unzima ngenkumbulo yokwaphulwa komthetho okwakhokelela kutshintsho olumangalisayo. Yayingoobani le miphefumlo, kwaye yayiluhlobo luni lovavanyo lwabo?
clues: Sasiluluntu olwalufumene umyalelo ocacileyo kwiNkosi yethu, kodwa safumana iindlela zokuwuchasa.
Sasihlala kufutshane namanzi amaninzi, kwaye indlela esasiphila ngayo yayixhomekeke kwizidalwa zawo.
Uvavanyo lwafika kuthi ngomhla esayalelwa ukuba sizikhwebule kwizinto zehlabathi.
Izidalwa zasemanzini zeza kuthi ngobuninzi ngaloo mini, zisilinga ngendlela engaphaya kokunyamezela.
Saceba iqhinga lokweqa umyalelo kaThixo, sicinga ukuba singawudlula ngobulumko loo myalelo.
Ukwaphulwa kwethu komthetho kwakhokelela kutshintsho oluhlazisayo; saba ziinkawu ezidelekileyo ngomyalelo ka-Allah.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
